notes: Sweep 2026-10-23 for shop-project with the skill: five runs (opus-1, haiku-1, haiku-2, sonnet-1, sonnet-2), all rc 0, model_id matching each tier, head d04061d with uncommitted false. skill_hash 005deae0a75971526e878940c13efb052c696a5b599949a07ecce352a8fc6e34 in every result.json equals common.folder_hash('idiomatic-elixir') at HEAD d04061d with a clean idiomatic-elixir/ and evals/cases, so the runs read the text graded here. skills_listed is 209 in every run, against 29 in 2026-10-22-d: these sessions were shown far more skills. Every run read SKILL.md first (#1) and ex_unit.md before its first edit; opus-1 also read library-design.md (#7). Thinking blocks are present but redacted.

Rules changed since the standard (2026-10-22-d at ba24972), per git diff ba24972 -- idiomatic-elixir/: new paragraphs under "Read required keys with `map.key` or a pattern; keep `map[:key]` for optional keys" (a body pattern that pulls one field is dot access written long; dot chains; get_in/1; Map.fetch/2), a rewrite of "In multi-clause functions, bind in the head only what patterns and guards use" (what selects a clause; required string keys in the head), and one added sentence on crash reports in ex_unit.md's capture_log rule. None of the case's seven rules changed, so all seven are graded to the 2026-10-22-d standard (a passing --check-formatted after a file's last edit counts as formatted for Before you finish step 1; a total that raises KeyError on an unpriced SKU is clean under the return-tuple rule when its @doc says so; a one-step with is a violation and a case for a single fallible call is not exercised; Map.put/3 on the inner items map inside %{cart | items: ...} is not the forbidden pattern; a code kept as a string and checked against a literal list is clean under the atom rule). The two changed rules are outside this case's list; no run breaks either (every multi-clause head binds only a literal, a guard's value or the `= cart` alias; the only head destructures are single-clause, such as the project's own total_quantity(%__MODULE__{items: items}) and subtotal_cents(%__MODULE__{items: items}, prices) in haiku-1 and haiku-2; no body pattern pulls a single field).

Per-sentence counts: the caller asked for a count of violating runs per bullet for the rewritten rules in webhook-parser.md and library-client.md. Neither case is graded here, and shop-project.md's "What to check" list has no per-sentence bullets for the rewritten rules, so there is nothing to count in this file. For this case: the one-step with sentence ("A `with` has at least two `<-` steps; one step is a `case`.") is broken by 1 of 5 runs (sonnet-1); every other graded rule, 0 of 5.

Per-file formatting check line: met in 1 of 5 (opus-1), the same as 2026-10-22-d. opus-1 wrote the test file first (#9), checked it alone with mix format --check-formatted test/shop/cart_test.exs (#11, passed) before running the tests (#12, failing as expected for undefined functions), then wrote cart.ex (#13) and checked it alone (#14, passed) before compiling (#15). haiku-1: Write cart.ex (#10), Write and Edit the test file (#11, #12), then one check on both files (#15) after a refused chain (#13). haiku-2: Write and Edit cart.ex (#5, #6), Write and four Edits of the test file (#7-#11), then mix format on both (#13) and the check on both (#14, FORMAT_OK). sonnet-1: a refused python3 heredoc (#5); Write and two Edits of cart.ex (#6-#8), Edit of the test file (#9), then mix format on both in the command that ran mix test (#10). sonnet-2: a refused python3 heredoc (#4); Write cart.ex (#5), Write the test file (#6), then one command (#7) that checked cart.ex alone (failed), formatted both, printed lines 30-42 of cart.ex and ran compile, test and Credo. In every Haiku and Sonnet run cart.ex was left for the test file before any format or check.

What the formatter changed, by replaying every successful Write and Edit onto the case's files and running mix format at each format call; with those changes applied, the replayed files are byte-identical to the final files in all five runs. opus-1 and haiku-1: nothing. haiku-2: in the test file, the |> line under one `assert {:ok, cart} =` (line 106) was re-indented from 8 to 15 spaces, the formatter's own indentation of a pipeline after `=`. sonnet-1: cart.ex's `subtotal = Enum.sum_by(cart.items, fn {sku, quantity} -> Map.fetch!(prices, sku) * quantity end)` wrapped after `=` (final lines 96-97); the session grepped for that line and moved on. sonnet-2: the same wrap after `=` (final lines 78-79), and three one-line case clauses in remove_item/3 split into block clauses (final lines 36-43) because the first was too long; the session read lines 30-42 after the format and kept them. No run met a do: body moved onto its own line or a literal argument spread over lines, so the Formatting bullet's rewrite half was not exercised.

Before you finish, 0 of 5 violated (2026-10-22-d: 1 of 5, sonnet-2, for never running Credo). opus-1: after its last edit (#13), check on cart.ex (#14; the test file was checked at #11 after its only edit), mix compile --warnings-as-errors --force (#15, no warnings), full mix test (#16, 20 passed), mix credo --strict (#17, no issues); never mix format itself, counted per the judgement call. haiku-1: after its last edit (#12), check on both files (#15), compile --warnings-as-errors --force (#16), full mix test (#17, 18 passed), mix credo --strict on the two files (#18, no issues); never mix format itself. haiku-2: after its last edit (#11), mix format and the check on both (#13, #14), full mix test (#15, 18 passed), mix credo --strict on the two files and mix compile --force --warnings-as-errors (#16). sonnet-1: after its last edit (#9), mix format on both and full mix test (#10, 19 passed), mix compile --force --warnings-as-errors and mix credo --strict (#11). sonnet-2: after its last edit (#6), #7 ran the format, mix compile --warnings-as-errors, full mix test (17 passed) and mix credo --strict (no issues).

Chain fallible steps with `with`: sonnet-1 writes a one-step with in apply_discount/2 (lines 73-75), the rule's first Instead of, so violated; it rejects a second code in the function head (line 78). opus-1, haiku-2 and sonnet-2 use case for the single fallible call (opus-1 lines 69-72, haiku-2 lines 67-70, sonnet-2 lines 63-66), and haiku-1 checks membership with if (line 58): not exercised. Against 2026-10-22-d, opus moves from clean (a two-step with) to not exercised; sonnet stays violated, from the same run position and the same shape.

Other rules, graded to the 2026-10-22-d standard. Atoms: opus-1 (lines 119-121), sonnet-1 (102-104) and sonnet-2 (84-86) use one parse clause per code string; haiku-2 trims and upcases, then maps with explicit case clauses (lines 88-92); haiku-1 keeps the trimmed, upcased string and checks it against @codes ~w(SAVE10 FREESHIP) (lines 9, 56-58), clean as in earlier grades. defstruct: [:items, :discount] in four runs, [:items, :code] in haiku-1, all bare atoms. Return tuples: atom or tagged-tuple reasons everywhere; every run raises KeyError on an unpriced SKU and says so in its @doc (opus-1 lines 94-95, haiku-1 80-81, haiku-2 76-77, sonnet-1 85-86, sonnet-2 72-73). Money: integer div in all five; opus-1, haiku-1, haiku-2 and sonnet-1 round halves up, sonnet-2 rounds the discounted subtotal down. Naming: domain names throughout, no boolean, get, fetch, size or length functions. other_violations: haiku-1 and haiku-2 multi-step pipes on one line and single-step pipes in doctests, under the pipeline rule as in earlier grades. The test pipelines starting with Cart.new() on separate lines follow the project's own test file and are not listed. Not a rule break, but haiku-2's test comment at line 108 ("so the discount is 11 cents and 94 cents remain") contradicts the assertion under it (95 + 499), which passes.
Expected reads: all five runs added tests and read ex_unit.md before their first edit (opus-1 #6, haiku-1 #8, haiku-2 #4, sonnet-1 #3, sonnet-2 #2), so the check is met 5 of 5, as in 2026-10-22-d.

Verified in scratch copies of each run's project (deps from one mix deps.get): mix format --check-formatted, mix compile --force --warnings-as-errors (no warnings), mix credo --strict (no issues) and mix test pass in all five: opus-1 20 (3 doctests), haiku-1 18 (2 doctests), haiku-2 18 (2 doctests), sonnet-1 19 (3 doctests), sonnet-2 17. A mix run probe with 2 x APPLE at 100 cents gives 699, 679 with SAVE10 and 200 with FREESHIP in all five. BOGUS returns {:error, {:unknown_discount_code, "BOGUS"}} in opus-1, {:error, {:unknown_code, "BOGUS"}} in sonnet-2 and {:error, :unknown_code} in the other three. A second code is rejected with {:error, :discount_already_applied} in opus-1 and sonnet-1 and replaces the first in haiku-1, haiku-2 and sonnet-2. Only the Haiku runs accept " save10 ". Removing 5 of 2 units empties the items, 1 of 2 leaves 1, and an absent SKU leaves the cart unchanged. No lib file has String.to_atom/1 or a float.
